slides.headline: 1) REPLACE ZAPIER WITH THIS FREE TOOL
slides.body: Zapier's Professional plan costs $49 a month. n8n, free on GitHub (github.com/n8n-io/n8n), connects all your apps and automates tasks in plain English, no code.

slides.headline: 2) TRANSCRIBE EVERY MEETING AND CALL FOR FREE
slides.body: Transcription services charge up to $1.50 a minute, over $4,000 a year for one busy team. Whisper, free on GitHub (github.com/openai/whisper), transcribes any audio file as accurately as any paid service.

slides.headline: 3) BUILD AN AI CHATBOT FOR YOUR WEBSITE TONIGHT
slides.body: Custom AI chatbots start at $5,000 to build and cost up to $300 a month. Flowise, free on GitHub (github.com/FlowiseAI/Flowise), lets you drag, drop, and point it at your FAQ, live in hours.

slides.headline: 4) FREE PRIVATE AI FOR YOUR WHOLE TEAM
slides.body: A 10-person team on ChatGPT Plus spends $2,400 a year and sends every message to OpenAI's servers. Ollama, free on GitHub (github.com/ollama/ollama), runs powerful private AI on your own machine for $0.

slides.headline: 5) ASK AI QUESTIONS ABOUT YOUR FILES AND CONTRACTS
slides.body: Services that let AI search your internal documents cost $300 to $800 a month. AnythingLLM, free on GitHub (github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm), connects AI to any file you upload and answers in seconds.

slides.headline: 6) FREE COMPETITOR RESEARCH IN UNDER A MINUTE
slides.body: Perplexity Pro costs $240 a year per person for AI-powered web research. Perplexica, free on GitHub (github.com/ItzCrazyKns/Perplexica), does the same thing and delivers a sourced competitor report in under a minute.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS POST
slides.body: You'll want these when you're cutting your software bill. Daily AI news and real tools, every day
